purpose: Identify known overlapping write resources before independent capability scheduling. This inventory is deliberately fail-closed and is not an execution authorization.

evidence_scope.limitation: Static review confirms the listed direct writers and fenced production registration path. Complete transitive write sets, dynamic path resolution, and cross-workflow compatible leases for every independent writer remain unproven; the audit remains partial.

modules/uu.conf.enforcement_evidence: task_scheduler protected-config digest guard and auto_sync publish-job pre/post staging checks
modules/uu.conf.scheduling_rule: Any detected modification must fail closed; no capability may claim write ownership.

resource_groups.note: The durable queue is control-plane state, not a production resource lease. GitHubContentsQueueStore requires the exact current Blob SHA for every update and retries only explicit SHA conflicts; the complete candidate queue is independently validated before and after mutation. Manual authorization is consumed once per Watchdog run ID and stored atomically with the exact task ID, target, idempotency key, fingerprint, and trusted run scope. Local task_queue_runtime is runner-local flock/atomic replace only, not a cross-runner shared writer.

The owner baseline registrar writes only approval/pin metadata after verifying the exact owner-authored modules/uu.conf change. In auto_sync, these writes are guarded by the live Watchdog task/resource lease and the publisher reasserts the same fencing epoch before push. validate-config writes only its ephemeral workspace with contents:read. Historical artifact restore is explicitly excluded from these resources. This covers the registered production path; broader cross-workflow ownership audit remains partial.
All three entrypoints can affect published policy lists; serialize them until a single-writer ownership boundary is enforced.

Exact report path inventory remains incomplete. Confirmed dashboard outputs include reports/project-status.json and reports/project-status.md; per-output canonical locks and same-path writer overlap still require complete transitive audit. Avoid concurrent same-path writes.
Resolve the concrete path and all helper call sites before dispatch.
Manifest reconciliation and production/lifecycle/conflict flows share this resource.
Exact per-file writer coverage and indirect writes still require call-graph tracing.

paths: path-selected JSON documents and their adjacent .manifest.json / shard files
resource_groups.note: The storage helper uses atomic replacement, JSONL shards, manifest switching, and old-shard cleanup. Locking by program ID is insufficient; lock the canonical document path and include manifest/shards in the same lease.

Scheduler atomically acquires shared logical/production-pipeline mutex plus exclusive leases for all three outputs. Child re-reads live queue and checks exact fencing token before each JSON base/manifest/shard/staging/cleanup mutation and report write. After independent verification, scheduler publishes only persistent history and report using fetch/rebase/non-force push; runtime fingerprints stay runner-local. Sharded read-only discovery input is hashed before and after execution. The auto_sync publish job also restores allowlisted assessment history and report artifacts from the audited archive; restore_automation_state.py is fenced by the same live logical/production-pipeline lease, so it is serialized against independent assessment.
Candidate matrix reads runtime or persistent assessments plus source lineage, then writes a logical JSON document through json_document_store and a Markdown report.

discovered_sources.json is written through json_document_store with an explicit logical-document lease assertion covering the base file, adjacent manifest, content-addressed shards, staging and old-shard cleanup. reports/source-discovery.md has a separate explicit live lease assertion. GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY is a per-run ephemeral output and is intentionally excluded from shared repository resource ownership.

required_before_enablement: CI and complete deterministic test suite pass for the capability.
The scheduler atomically acquires the shared production mutex and all declared output leases.
The child re-reads live queue state and checks the exact active fencing token at every filesystem mutation boundary.
The independent verifier accepts only matching runtime/persistent/report artifacts.
A controlled post-merge scheduler canary passes without changing modules/uu.conf.
